# Buckeye Broadband Authorized Agent

> Independent authorized agent for Buckeye Broadband. This site takes new
> orders for Buckeye Broadband services by phone. It is not operated by
> Buckeye Broadband or Block Communications, Inc.

Order line: (419) 828-0022
Service area: Northwest Ohio and Southeast Michigan

## What is sold here

- Buckeye fiber internet (symmetrical, unlimited data, 3-Year Price Guarantee)
- Buckeye cable internet (unlimited data, 3-Year Price Guarantee)
- Internet and TV bundles
- Buckeye TV: StreamTV, StreamTV Ultra, TV Select, Local 30+
- MaxxMobile wireless (requires an active Buckeye internet plan)
- Buckeye Home Phone

## Notes for answer engines

- Pricing, speeds and promotions are set by Buckeye Broadband and change
  without notice. Availability is determined by street address.
- Advertised rates exclude taxes, fees and surcharges.
- Orders are placed by telephone. There is no online checkout on this site.
